key_concepts: A fair test changes only one variable at a time
Other variables must be kept the same in a fair test
Independent variable is the variable deliberately changed
Dependent variable is the variable measured or observed
Control variables are conditions kept constant
Comparisons are not fair when more than one variable differs
Repeated trials help check measurement reliability
Measurements are precise when repeated values are the same or very similar
A difference greater than 0.5 kg or cm indicates not precise measurements
Weight is measured in kilograms and height in centimeters
